description: Shell terminal. Typing goes to the shell prompt at the bottom.
tips: Run a command: type_text the command followed by \n (no need to click first; the terminal has focus).
Wait a moment for long-running commands, then read the output before declaring done.
Put the relevant command output in the done action's text so the user sees the answer.
Commands that delete files, use sudo or change the system require the user's approval.
ctrl+c cancels a running command; ctrl+shift+c / ctrl+shift+v copy and paste.
